caveats: The RBR analysis does not distinguish whether burned land was before or after the harvest of the specific cropland.
name: northern-syria-burned-land-analysis-dataset-may-june-2019
notes: Using 10m resolution multispectral imagery from the Sentinel-2A satellite, a relativized burn ratio (RBR) was calculated and used for burned land classification to assess and quantify areas which have been burned between 4 May and 30 June 2019 in the governorates of Al-Hasakeh, Deir-ez-Zor, Ar-Raqqa, Aleppo, Idleb and Northern Hama. The before and after images are composites ranging from 6 April to 3 May 2019 and 27 to 30 June 2019.
